**SR08 — Arvind’s Forbidden Thoughts**  
09:20–09:40 AM · Rathore residence · Outer storage area  
*Arvind’s private POV — Shreya physically absent, on duty at police station*

Arvind outer storage area mein aaya. Wahan Shreya ka gym bag thoda ajeeb angle se pada tha, zip half open, aur kuch kapda andar se bahar nikal ke atka hua tha. Woh bag ko utha ke theek se shelf pe rakhne laga.

Jab usne stuck kapda andar theek kiya, tab usko feel hua ki fabric thoda damp hai. Bag ke andar se subah ke workout clothes dikh gaye — red sports bra aur matching pants. Kapda abhi bhi paseene se geela tha. Sports bra ke andar wale hisse pe milk leakage ka halka white mark bhi saaf dikh raha tha.

Arvind ne bag ko shelf pe rakh diya, lekin haath ruk gaya. Usne bra ko ek second ke liye haath mein liya. Kapda garam aur thoda chipchipa laga. Usne pehle naram sa smell liya — fresh workout sweat aur uski body ka scent. Saans tez ho gayi. Phir dheere se usne bra ko munh ke paas laaya aur milk stain wale hisse ko lick kiya. Ek dheemi groan nikal gayi.

Subah wali Shreya turant dimaag mein aa gayi — red outfit mein confident, thodi si sweat se chamakti hui, uski taraf muskura ke dekh rahi thi. Imagination mein woh uske saamne bra utaar rahi thi, milky breasts fully exposed, nipples thode stiff, milk ki halki leakage abhi bhi.

Phir usne pants bhi haath mein liye. Intimate area ke damp fabric ko usne deeply smell kiya, phir tongue se lick kiya. Doosri groan tez ho gayi.

Uske mind mein scene aur gahra ho gaya. Shreya gym mein forward bend kar rahi hai, pants tight aur sweat se chipki hui, aur woh usse dekh ke jaanti hai ki woh kahan dekh raha hai. Phir woh uske paas aati hai, uski haath pakad ke apni bra ke andar le jaati hai, uski ungliyon ko milk-damp skin pe feel karwati hai.

Arvind ne aankhein kholi. Woh abhi bhi akela tha. Bag ab theek se shelf pe pada tha. Shreya police station mein thi, bilkul unaware.

Usne clothes wapas bag mein rakh diye, zip band ki, aur room se nikal gaya. Lekin andar jo obsession jaag gayi thi, woh ab easily nahi jaane wali thi.
